bases.h10/h15/ceil/flr/sd: MEASURED from real 2025 weekly scores, min 8 games
bases.h10a: ROLE-ADJUSTED expected 2026 ten-point rate: his own 2025 weekly shape rescaled to his 2026 projected level, then recounted. This is the number decisions run on. h10 (the raw 2025 rate) is kept for display only - it describes a role the player may no longer have
bases.k: 2026 projected points per game divided by 2025 actual points per game. Below ~0.7 means the role shrank; above ~1.3 means it grew
bases.mb: M = has >=8 games of 2025 history. N = does not; nothing is interpolated
bases.opp: factual 2026 opponent by week. No difficulty rating - none is defensible here
bases.pts: season PPR projection. 'blend' = Rotowire+ESPN equal weight; 'rotowire only' = single source, off the 260-man draft board
bases.role: LOST / SAME / GAINED - the direction h10a moved against h10
bases.sr: startable_rate, measured against this league's own weekly baseline; null for pool-only players whose baseline was not computed
bases.wp: Sleeper per-week PPR projection, keyed by real NFL week. A week absent means NOT PROJECTED (bye, or no projection issued) - not zero

meta.variance_definition: startable_rate = share of the player's JUDGED 2025 weeks in which he outscored this league's own baseline at his position that real week (QB12/RB31/WR51/TE14). A week with fewer than N players at the position has no baseline and is excluded from numerator and denominator; weeks_judged reports how many weeks actually counted.

weekly_proj.note: per-week PPR projections; a player absent from a week is not projected, not zero
